properties.name: Proof tracking: confirmation on each inference step, proof status on conclusions, CONTRADICTS truth
properties.rationale: Implements the three parts of requirement B (req:a-design-can-be-a-proof) that must land before the primes trial: (1) confirmation tracking so a proof can distinguish human-checked steps from unconfirmed narration, (2) proof_status computation so a conclusion knows its standing, and (3) counterexample truth propagation so a CONTRADICTS edge breaks the conclusions resting on it. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Each inference step now records who confirmed it (confirmed_by, confirmed_how, confirmed_at). get_node on a conclusion returns proof_status: proven when every step in a holding chain is confirmed, shown when the chain holds but has unconfirmed steps, unproven when no derivation holds. A CONTRADICTS edge with opposing alignment makes the target's truth fail, propagating through downstream inference chains.
